prompt.generated_prompt_string: An unplanned paparazzi-style portrait capturing a raw candid moment. A generic adult woman walks through a crowded street, head slightly lowered before glancing sideways toward the camera with a calm confident expression. The tight 9:16 close-up includes only face, neck and part of shoulder. She wears the exact same approved outfit as the reference photo, with no changes in color or detail, plus black sunglasses and slightly tousled hair. The background contains blurred silhouettes, flashing cameras and city lights smeared by motion, conveying a fashion-week crowd. Harsh on-camera flash illuminates face and sunglasses, with gritty high-ISO texture, cool tones, strong contrast and European fashion-week atmosphere. Glamorous yet completely unplanned.
